stitch.content.h1: What Is Image Stitching and How Does Digital Compositing Work?
stitch.content.p1a: Image stitching is a digital photo composition technique that combines multiple independent photographs or graphical assets into a single cohesive image. Rather than manual copy-pasting in heavy desktop editing software, modern canvas stitching calculates spatial coordinates, scales aspect ratios proportionately, and composites pixel matrices in real-time.
stitch.content.p1b: ImgFeel's Image Stitching Tool handles everything directly within your local browser using HTML5 Canvas. You can effortlessly combine before-and-after photo comparisons, join panoramic landscape triptychs, stack long chat conversation screenshots, or build elegant social media grid collages with pixel-perfect margins and custom background fills.
stitch.content.feat1Desc: Automatically equalize image heights for horizontal stitching or widths for vertical stacking without distortion.
stitch.content.feat2Desc: Switch instantly between horizontal ribbons, vertical screenshot strips, and 2-column or 3-column photo grids.
stitch.content.feat3Desc: All canvas compositing and file exporting happen strictly inside your browser memory. Zero images are uploaded to any server.
stitch.content.feat4Desc: Customize inter-image gaps, canvas margins, corner rounding radii, and transparent or custom hex background colors.
stitch.content.h2: Horizontal vs. Vertical vs. Grid Stitching: Which Layout Is Right?
stitch.content.p2a: Choosing the appropriate stitching orientation depends on the narrative flow and distribution platform of your visual content. Horizontal side-by-side stitching is optimal for comparing two or three images directly, such as fitness before-and-after transformations, architectural redesigns, or widescreen website header banners.
stitch.content.p2b: Vertical stacked stitching is the gold standard for continuous scrollable media, including multi-part mobile text message screenshots, digital comic strips, step-by-step cooking recipes, and mobile infographics. Meanwhile, 2-column and 3-column grid collages provide balanced editorial layouts for portfolio showcases, Instagram posts, and e-commerce product catalogs.
stitch.content.h3: Top Practical Applications of Merging Images Online
stitch.content.p3a: Combining pictures into a single file simplifies sharing and improves presentation across numerous professional and personal use cases.
stitch.content.p3b: E-commerce sellers frequently merge multiple product angles (front, back, details) into a single composite image to save marketplace listing fees and provide customers with an all-in-one visual summary. Social media creators stitch sequential photos into aesthetic moodboards. Researchers and developers stitch charts, diagrams, and code snippets into clean comparison reports.

stitch.content.h5: Preserving Sharpness & Aspect Ratios Without Blurriness
stitch.content.p5a: Poorly configured stitching tools often stretch or squish photos unnaturally when attempting to align different resolutions. ImgFeel calculates proportional scaling factors based on geometric aspect ratios ($W / H$).
stitch.content.p5b: When you choose 'Auto-Match Sizes', all photos are scaled proportionately using high-quality bicubic canvas sampling so every image maintains crisp edge sharpness, rich color fidelity, and natural proportions without distortion.
stitch.content.h6: Custom Margins, Corner Rounding, and Transparent Backgrounds
stitch.content.p6a: Polished graphic designs require control over whitespace and borders. With ImgFeel, you can adjust the inner spacing gap between photos from 0px (seamless edge-to-edge join) up to 80px.
stitch.content.p6b: You can also add outer canvas margins, round the corners of each individual picture, and select transparent alpha fills for transparent PNG overlays or solid colored backdrops (white, dark slate, black, or custom hex codes).

stitch.faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
stitch.faq.q1: How do I combine multiple images into one online for free?
stitch.faq.a1: Upload your photos to ImgFeel's Image Stitching Tool above, choose your desired layout (Horizontal, Vertical, or Grid), adjust spacing and margins, and click Download Stitched Image.
stitch.faq.q2: Can I reorder the images after uploading them?
stitch.faq.a2: Yes! The loaded images strip at the top features move left/up (<) and move right/down (>) buttons so you can arrange your pictures in any desired sequence.
stitch.faq.q3: Does stitching lower the image quality or introduce compression artifacts?
stitch.faq.a3: No. ImgFeel composites your pictures at their full native pixel resolutions and allows lossless PNG export for maximum fidelity.
stitch.faq.q4: Can I combine images with different dimensions and aspect ratios?
stitch.faq.a4: Yes. ImgFeel's Auto-Match mode intelligently equalizes heights for horizontal stitching and widths for vertical stitching while maintaining natural aspect ratios.
stitch.faq.a5: Yes, 100%. Selecting the transparent background option preserves alpha channel transparency in both PNG and WebP formats.
stitch.faq.q6: Is there a limit on how many images I can stitch together?
stitch.faq.a6: You can combine dozens of images smoothly. Because processing runs client-side in your browser, performance depends on your device's memory.
stitch.faq.q7: Are my uploaded photos uploaded or stored on any server?
stitch.faq.a7: No! All image compositing and canvas rendering take place 100% inside your local browser memory. Zero files are uploaded to any server.
